title: Vampire Vape Tropical Passionfruit Splash Flavour Concentrate 30ml
description: Passionfruit Splash Flavour Concentrate from Vampire Vape’s Tropical collection captures a creamy medley of Curuba, Passionfruit and Banana for DIY e-liquid mixing. The Curuba delivers a tart, fruity edge with notes of peach and citrus, while Passionfruit adds a tropical tang and subtle sweetness. Banana completes the blend with a mellow, smooth finish that enhances the body of your e-liquid. This 30ml concentrate is designed for use in DIY e-liquid creation and must be diluted before vaping. Ideal for experienced mixers looking to customise VG/PG ratios and nicotine strengths. Vampire Vape concentrates are developed in the UK and are a popular choice among DIY vapers seeking rich, consistent flavour. Also available in Nic Salt, Freebase and Shortfill formats.
